summary: Current official remote metadata and setup docs advertise Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.webflow.com/mcp, while the repository README retains an /sse example; the transport contract is version-skewed.

Webflow documents manual connection for any MCP-compatible client plus explicit setup paths for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Postman, and Windsurf; remote setup includes automatic Bridge App installation during authorization.

The official OSS entrypoint is a local stdio server: it requires WEBFLOW_TOKEN, constructs WebflowClient, registers tools, and connects StdioServerTransport; package metadata exposes dist/index.js and the README provides npx setup.
The source taxonomy separates Data API groups, live Designer groups, rules, and OSS-only local Designer connection tools; the repository tree mirrors those capability domains.

Current docs describe read-only MCP resources and a Webflow Guide, but the repository README says prompts/resources are not included; deployed remote and public OSS surfaces cannot be assumed identical.
